short: end piece of an indigenous name
notes: Card: 'u', 'al', 'mi', 'ame', 're', 'ala', ' Rock' with names like Ningaloo, Sami, Kamehameha, Batu, Tabelbala; plus ' rocks', ' hills', 'aves', custodians. Probes: 'u' in Batu 0.828, 'i' in Sami 0.817, 'al' in Ningaloo 0.709, 'ori' in Maori 0.538; ' rocks' 0.780, ' caves' 0.708 were strong but 'cliffs and dunes' 0.037 was not, so landforms are outside this label. English town-frame near misses under 0.1. Near misses use European names in the same frames.
